lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Eight distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible. Spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section, narrowing and becoming irregular towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the dorsal origin of the 6th vertical stripe (counting from anterior to posterior).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1, 8, and 9 exhibit significant discontinuity; Stripe 1 is abbreviated at the shoulder, while stripes 8 and 9 terminate in fragmented segments mid-torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 9-11 discrete white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, with highest density localized on the mid-posterior flank.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hindquarter align vertically, following the projected path of the 8th lateral line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white dorsal crest of elongated hair along the spinal ridge and high-contrast tan/orange 'sock' markings on the lower distal limbs.
